 Speaker’s Card/Request to Speak: If you would like to address the City Council on a scheduled agenda
 item, please complete the speaker’s form. The card is at the table at the entrance to the Council
 Chamber. Please identify on the card your name, address, and the item on which you would like to speak
 and return to the City Clerk. The speaker’s form assists the Mayor in ensuring that all persons wishing to
 address the Council are recognized. Your name will be called at the time the matter is heard by the
 Council.

ROLL CALL

1.  STUDY SESSION/WORKSHOPS/SCOPING SESSIONS

1.1  SCOPING SESSION FOR A GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT FOR THE
  LAMBERT RANCH RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT IN PLANNING AREA 6

  ACTION:
  1)  Receive staff report.
  2)  Council comments and questions.

ADOPTION OF CONSENT CALENDAR IF TIME ALLOWS

RECESS - 4:45 RECEPTION IN LOBBY FOR EARNED INCOME TAX CREDIT
VOLUNTEERS

RECONVENE TO THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING - 5:00 P.M.
 City Council Agenda  May 23, 2006

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

MOMENT OF SILENCE

MUSICAL PRESENTATIONS

2.  PRESENTATIONS

2.1  Proclaim June 3, 2006 as "United We Paint Day"

2.2  Proclaim May 29-September 4, 2006 as "Drowning Prevention and
  Awareness Summer"

2.3  Presentation by the Youth Action Team

2.4  Report on the Earned Income Tax Credit Program and Commendations to
  Volunteers

INTRODUCTIONS

CITY MANAGERS REPORT

ANNOUNCEMENTS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/COUNCIL REPORTS

  Announcements, Committee Reports and Council Comments are for the purpose of presenting
  brief comments or reports, are subject to California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and are limited to 15-minutes per meeting.

ADDITIONS AND DELETIONS

  Additions to the agenda are limited by California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and for those items that arise after the posting of the Agenda and must be acted upon
  prior to the next City Council meeting.

3.  CONSENT CALENDAR (Item Nos. 3.1 thru 3.13)

  All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and all will be enacted by
  one roll call vote. There will be no discussion of these items unless members of the City Council
  request specific items to be removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion. Any
  member of the public may address the Council on items on the Consent Calendar. Public
  comments on any item or items on the consent calendar are limited to three minutes per
  speaker. If you wish to speak to a particular item or items, please complete a Speakers Form
  and give it to the City Clerk. Please see information in Request to Speak section.

3.1  APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  2
 City Council Agenda  May 23, 2006

  ACTION:  Approve the minutes of a regular meeting of the City Council
  held on May 9, 2006.

3.2  PROCLAMATIONS: May 14-20, 2006, as "Emergency Medical Services Week"

3.3  MAP, BONDS, AND AGREEMENTS, FOR TRACT MAP NO. 16666 (PLANNING
  AREA 9C-1, WOODBURY EAST)

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve Tract Map No. 16666.
  2)  Approve the agreements and accept the security from Irvine Community
  Development Company, LLC., guaranteeing improvements for Tract Map
  No. 16666, and authorize the Mayor to sign and the City Clerk to attest to
  the agreements subject to City Attorney approval as to form.
  3)  Accept the dedication of easements for emergency access and public
  service vehicle ingress and egress, traffic control systems and loop
  detectors, and trail and sidewalk purposes as shown on the map.
  4)  Accept the dedication of an easement for public street and public utility
  purposes within Tract Map No. 16666 for the following streets right-of-way:
  Sand Canyon Avenue and Trabuco Road.
  5)  Adopt a Resolution entitled: RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ACCEPTING THE
  STREETS NAMED: SAND CANYON AVENUE AND TRABUCO ROAD,
  WITHIN TRACT MAP NO. 16666 INTO THE SYSTEM OF CITY
  STREETS.

3.4  AGREEMENT FOR JOINT POLICE SERVICES BETWEEN THE CITY OF
  IRVINE AND THE CITY OF TUSTIN

  ACTION:  Authorize the City Manager to execute and the City Clerk to
  attest to an agreement between the City of Irvine and the City of Tustin for
  joint police services by authorizing select members of the Tustin Police
  Department to join the Irvine Police Department Special Weapons and
  Tactics Team commencing June 1, 2006.

3.5  CONSULTANT SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH ARROYO ASSOCIATES TO
  CONDUCT A LIBRARY NEEDS ASSESSMENT

  ACTION:
  1)  Authorize the Mayor to execute, and the City Clerk to attest to a consultant
  contract with Arroyo Associates, Inc. to conduct a Library Needs
  Assessment subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
  2)  Approve the attached budget adjustment in the amount of $89,600 for a
  Library Needs Assessment.

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  3
 City Council Agenda  May 23, 2006

3.6  SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE FY2004 URBAN AREAS SECURITY
  INITIATIVE GRANT

  ACTION:
  1)  Accept an amendment to the FY2004 Urban Areas Security Initiative grant
  award in the amount of $100,000.
  2)  Authorize the Director of Public Safety to execute, and the City Clerk to
  attest to, the Second Amendment to Agreement for the FY2004 Urban
  Areas Security Initiative between the City of Irvine and the City of Santa
  Ana.
  3)  Approve a budget adjustment request form in the amount of $100,000,
  reflecting $100,000 in revenues and appropriations.

3.7  APPROVAL OF PLANS, SPECIFICATIONS, AND CONTRACT DOCUMENTS
  FOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL SYSTEMS UPGRADES ALONG HARVARD
  (CIP335110), BONITA CANYON (335080), AND IRVINE BOULEVARD (CIP
  335090)

  ACTION:  Approve the plans, specifications, and contract documents
  on file with the Public Works Department for the following projects:

  a. Harvard Avenue Traffic Signal Systems Upgrade, CIP 335110.

  b. Bonita Canyon Drive Traffic Signal Systems Upgrade, CIP 335080.

  c. Irvine Boulevard Traffic Signal Systems Upgrade, CIP 335090.

3.8  VACATION OF A PORTION OF SAND CANYON AVENUE (PLANNING AREA
  9C-1, WOODBURY EAST, AND PLANNING AREA 9C-2, STONEGATE EAST)

  ACTION:  Adopt a Resolution entitled: RESOLUTION NO. - A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE TO
  ORDER THE VACATION OF A PORTION OF SAND CANYON AVENUE
  BETWEEN PORTOLA PARKWAY AND TRABUCO ROAD, PLANNING
  AREA 9C-1, (WOODBURY EAST) AND PLANNING AREA 9C-2
  (STONEGATE EAST) PURSUANT TO CHAPTER 4, SUMMARY
  VACATION, STREETS AND HIGHWAYS CODE SECTION 8330 ET
  SEQ. AND CHAPTER 6, EFFECT OF VACATION, STREETS AND
  HIGHWAYS CODE SECTION 8356

3.9  TRACT MAP NO. 16843 (PLANNING AREA 36, IRVINE BUSINESS COMPLEX)

  ACTION:  Approve Tract Map No. 16843.

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  4
 City Council Agenda  May 23, 2006

3.10  WARRANT AND WIRE TRANSFER RESOLUTION

  ACTION:  Adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF IRVINE ALLOWING CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS.

3.11  VENTA SPUR TRAIL/JEFFREY ROAD PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE
  OVERCROSSING - FEASIBILITY STUDY

  ACTION:  Approve a budget adjustment to appropriate $100,000 from
  the General Fund account fund balance and create a new Capital
  Improvement Project for the preparation of a feasibility study for the Venta
  Spur Trail/Jeffrey Road Pedestrian Bridge Overcrossing.

3.12  MAP, BOND, AND AGREEMENT, FOR TRACT MAP NO. 16690 (PLANNING
  AREA 9, WOODBURY)

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve Tract Map No. 16690.
  2)  Approve the agreement and accept the security from The Irvine
  Community Development Company LLC, guaranteeing survey
  monumentation for Tract Map No. 16690, and authorize the Mayor to sign
  and the City Clerk to attest to the agreement subject to City Attorney
  approval as to form.
  3)  Accept the dedication of an easement for emergency access, public
  service vehicle ingress and egress, sidewalk access, and public utility
  purposes, as shown on the map.

3.13  CITY AUTHORIZATION TO INITIATE A GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT AND
  ZONE CHANGE FOR THE GREAT PARK CORPORATION AND LENNAR AT
  HERITAGE FIELDS

  ACTION:  Direct staff to initiate a general plan amendment and zone
  change to allow limited zoning revisions and zoning clarifications in
  Planning Areas 30 and 51 including the creation of a Lifelong Learning
  District proposed by Heritage Fields and to allow minor boundary
  adjustments proposed by the Great Park Corporation.

END OF CONSENT CALENDAR

4.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  Public Hearings are scheduled for a time certain of 4:00 p.m., unless noticed otherwise, or as
  soon thereafter as possible. Those wishing to address the City Council during the Public
  Hearing must complete a Request to Speak form and provide it to the City Clerk prior to the
  hearing. If, in the future, you wish to challenge in court any of the matters on this agenda for
  which a public hearing is to be conducted, you may be limited to raising only those issues which

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  5
 City Council Agenda  May 23, 2006

  you, or someone else raised orally at the public hearing or in written correspondence received by
  the City at or before the hearing. Any person seeking to challenge a City Council decision made
  as a result of a proceeding in which by law a hearing is required to be given, evidence is required
  to be taken, and the discretion in the determination of facts is vested in the City Council, shall be
  required to commence that action 90 days following the date on which the decision becomes
  final as provided in Code of Civil Procedure Section 1094.6. Please refer to Code of Civil
  Procedure 1094.6 to determine how to calculate when a decision becomes final.
  Notice: Public Hearings listed for continuance will be continued as noted and posting of this
  agenda serves as notice of continuation. Any matter not noted for continuance, will be posted
  separately.

4.1  PUBLIC HEARING: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF IRVINE ADDING CHAPTER 5 OF DIVISION 9 OF TITLE 5 TO THE IRVINE
  MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING CONSTRUCTION SITE AND VACANT
  PROPERTY SECURITY

  ACTION:
  1)  Open the public hearing.
  2)  Receive staff report.
  3)  Receive public comments.
  4)  Council comments and questions.
  5)  Close the public hearing.
  6)  Introduce for first reading and read by title only an ORDINANCE OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ADDING CHAPTER 5 OF
  DIVISION 9 OF TITLE 5 TO THE IRVINE MUNICIPAL CODE
  REGARDING CONSTRUCTION SITE AND VACANT PROPERTY
  SECURITY.

5.  COUNCIL BUSINESS

5.1  ISSUANCE OF FIXED RATE BONDS FOR COMMUNITY FACILITIES
  DISTRICT NO. 2005-2 (COLUMBUS GROVE)

  ACTION:  Adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF IRVINE, ACTING AS THE LEGISLATIVE BODY OF
  COMMUNITY FACILITIES DISTRICT NO. 2005-2 (COLUMBUS GROVE)
  OF THE CITY OF IRVINE, AUTHORIZING THE ISSUANCE OF ITS 2006
  SPECIAL TAX BONDS IN A PRINCIPAL AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED
  TWENTY-FIVE MILLION DOLLARS ($25,000,000) AND APPROVING
  CERTAIN DOCUMENTS AND TAKING CERTAIN OTHER ACTIONS IN
  CONNECTION THEREWITH.

5.2  RESOLUTION SUPPORTING MEASURE A AT THE JUNE 6, 2006 PRIMARY
  ELECTION

  ACTION:  Adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF IRVINE SUPPORTING MEASURE A, COUNTY OF ORANGE,
  ORDINANCE PROHIBITING THE EXERCISE OF EMINENT DOMAIN

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  6
 City Council Agenda  May 23, 2006

5.3  TASKS TWO THROUGH FIVE - GREAT PARK MASTER PLAN

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve the revised Scope of Work for Tasks Two through Five for the
  Master Plan of the Orange County Great Park.
  2)  Authorize the Mayor to sign a Novation Agreement to assign the
  Agreement for Master Designer Services to the City of Irvine, including a
  staff recommended budget not to exceed $9,575,000 for Tasks Two
  through Five.

5.4  ORANGE COUNTY GREAT PARK FUNDING

  ACTION:  Review and consider adopting a Resolution that precludes
  the use of General Fund revenues for the planning, construction, or
  operation of the Orange County Great Park.

5.5  IMPLEMENTATION OF IRVINE'S LOBBYIST REGISTRATION AND
  REPORTING ORDINANCE

END OF COUNCIL BUSINESS

PUBLIC COMMENTS (Limited to 3 minutes per speaker) - 6:00 P.M.

ADJOURNMENT

Next Meeting: CITY COUNCIL ADJOURNED REGULAR meeting, June 13, 2006, 3:00
p.m., City of Irvine, City Council Chamber, One Civic Center Plaza, Irvine, California.
  NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
  ADJOURNMENT
At 11:00 p.m., the City Council will determine which of the remaining agenda items can be considered
and acted upon prior to 12:00 midnight and will continue all other items on which additional time is
required until a future City Council meeting. All meetings are scheduled to terminate at 12:00 midnight.

  STAFF REPORTS

As a general rule, staff reports or other written documentation have been prepared or organized with
respect to each item of business listed on the agenda. Copies of these materials are on file with the City
Clerk and are available for public inspection and copying. If you have any questions regarding any item of
business on the agenda for this meeting, or any of the staff reports or other documentation relating to any
agenda item, please contact City Clerk staff at (949)724-6205.

  CITY SERVICES TO FACILITATE ACCESS TO PUBLIC MEETINGS

It is the intention of the City of Irvine to comply with the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) in all
respects. If, as an attendee or a participant at this meeting, you will need special assistance beyond what

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  7
 City Council Agenda  May 23, 2006

is normally provided, the City of Irvine will attempt to accommodate you in every reasonable manner.
Please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (949)724-6205.

Assisted listening devices are available at the meeting for individuals with hearing impairments.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35. 104 ADA Title II)

  CHALLENGING CITY DECISIONS

The time limit within which to commence any lawsuit or legal challenge to any quasi-adjudicative decision
made by the City is governed by Section 1094.6 of the Code of Civil Procedure, unless a shorter
limitations period is specified by any other provision. Under Section 1094.6, any lawsuit or legal challenge
  th
to any quasi-adjudicative decision made by the City must be filed no later than the 90 day following the
date on which such decision becomes final. Any lawsuit or legal challenge, which is not filed within that
90-day period, will be barred.

If a person wishes to challenge the nature of the above actions in court, they may be limited to raising
only those issues they or someone else raised at the meeting described in this notice, or in written
correspondence delivered to the City of Irvine, at or prior to the meeting. In addition, judicial challenge
may be limited or barred where the interested party has not sought and exhausted all available
administrative remedies.

  COMMUNICATION DEVICES

To minimize distractions, please be sure all personal communication devices are turned off or on silent
mode.
  MEETING SCHEDULE

Regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesdays of each month at 4:00
p.m. Study Sessions and/or Closed Sessions are periodically held prior to the start of the regular meeting.
Agendas are available as follows:

  Police Department
  Local library
  FAX Library System (Dial (949) 724-6210 and request document number 100 anytime after 5:00
  p.m. on the Friday prior to a City Council meeting)
